title: Minimal Distinction Density Definition
purpose: Define distinction density as an RT-native bridge quantity through an organizational definition that remains faithful to RT-first ontology and prevents implicit importation of metric mathematics.
summary: This patch introduces distinction density as a provisional bridge quantity defined organizationally as the ordered concentration of admissible non-null distinction relative to declared reference phi. Any later representational equation is downstream and does not serve as the ontological definition.

basis.scope: Provisional distinction-density witness that defines an RT-native bridge quantity downstream of the governed eligibility results while leaving RT_core unchanged and keeping bridge promotion deferred.

core_rule.statement: DISTINCTION_DENSITY(x, phi) may be introduced only as an RT-native bridge quantity after phi is declared. Bridge quantities are defined by organizational behavior before representational mathematics, and any later mathematical form is downstream of that definition.

DistinctionDensity.definition: The ordered concentration of admissible non-null distinction relative to declared reference phi.
DistinctionDensity.organization_definition: The organizational condition describing how admissible distinction is distributed within the continuation structure determined by phi.
DistinctionDensity.projection_note: Probability, statistics, entropy, spatial density, metric density, and propagation quantities are downstream projections of distinction density and are not part of its definition.

ResolutionWindow.definition: The declared continuation window that bounds the governed reading of distinction density.

OrderedDistinction.definition: The governed ordering of non-null distinction available for admissible continuation.

formal_reading.quantity: The ordered concentration of admissible non-null distinction relative to declared reference phi.
formal_reading.interpretation: Probability, statistics, entropy, spatial density, metric density, and propagation quantities are downstream projections and are not part of the definition.

governance_rules.rule: Distinction density may be used only after phi is declared.
Distinction density is a bridge quantity, not a primitive.
A defined distinction density does not validate DENSITY_BRIDGE_001; it only supplies a candidate quantity for later projection tests.

governing_properties.property: rho_D increases when admissible distinction becomes more organizationally concentrated.
rho_D decreases when admissible distinction becomes more organizationally diffuse.
rho_D is reference-dependent through the declared phi.
rho_D does not require a metric space.
rho_D is invariant under lawful representational rebinding.

governance_additions.rule: Bridge quantities shall be defined by organizational behavior before representational mathematics.
Representational equations may be introduced only after the bridge quantity has been independently defined.
No mathematical representation shall be interpreted as the ontological definition of a bridge quantity.

non_claims: Does not assert external physical truth.
Does not assert a completed metric.
Does not require a metric space.

counterexample_record.target: Any claim that distinction density is equivalent to probability
counterexample_record.counterexample: A system may exhibit organized non-null distinction before any statistical ensemble, frequency distribution, or probability measure is declared.
counterexample_record.ruling: Probability is downstream projection, not identity.
